const express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// Enable CORS and JSON body parsing
app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json());

// In-memory data store (Simulated Database)
let dataStore = [
  { id: 1, title: "Initial Project 2 Task", status: "completed" }
];

// 1. GET Endpoint - Retrieve Data
app.get('/api/tasks', (req, res) => {
  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    data: dataStore
  });
});

// 2. POST Endpoint - Create Data with Data Validation
app.post('/api/tasks', (req, res) => {
  const { title } = req.body;

  // Gatekeeper Rule: Input Validation
  if (!title || typeof title !== 'string' || title.trim() === '') {
    return res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: "400 Bad Request: 'title' is required and must be a valid string."
    });
  }

  const newTask = {
    id: dataStore.length + 1,
    title: title.trim(),
    status: "pending"
  };

  dataStore.push(newTask);

  return res.status(201).json({
    success: true,
    message: "Task successfully created.",
    data: newTask
  });
});

// 3. Fallback Route - 404 Handler
app.use((req, res) => {
  res.status(404).json({
    success: false,
    error: "404 Not Found: Endpoint does not exist."
  });
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`DecodeLabs API running at http://localhost:${PORT}`);
});
